newsitem.title: UK: McCartney injunction to stop "Penny Lane" sale.
newsitem.headline: McCartney injunction to stop "Penny Lane" sale.

text.p: Sir Paul McCartney on Friday obtained a High Court injunction to stop the sale of the original lyrics to "Penny Lane," one of the Beatles' biggest hits.

The action stops the original draft of the 1966 song being put up for auction at a special weekend sale of Beatles memorabilia being staged simultaneously over the weekend in Tokyo and London. Geoff Baker, spokesman for the recently knighted Beatle, said he believed the owner of the Number One hit was not entitled to sell the draft, which had been valued at 50,000 pounds ($79,780). No further details were given.
The auctioneers Bonhams said they would not be contesting the injunction. Up to 300 lots are being put up for sale.
